paragraphs: R. Yehudah ben Pappos: Samuel Midrash, chapter 23; Jerusalem Berakhot, end of chapter 2; Jerusalem Bava Batra, HaSefinah. R. Gamliel asked R. Yehoshua, “Who is this walking, etc.?” R. Yehoshua said, “This is R. Yehudah ben Pappos, whose deeds are all for Heaven's sake.” See Pappos ben Yehudah above.
